purpose: Separate signal-side integer-share quantization reserve from execution friction and determine what quote mechanism would be required if the suggested quantity were submitted unchanged.
benchmarkRule: A sub-1000 or mixed suggested quantity cannot use the default regular-lot quote as a certified executable benchmark for the odd-lot leg. Actual mechanism still requires order-submission evidence.
costFirewall: quantization residual cash is not commission
quantization residual cash is not tax
quantization residual cash is not slippage
signal market price is not a broker fill
suggested quantity is not proof an order was submitted
maturityRule: Positive signal examples can validate the geometry and reveal benchmark-mechanism demand, but cannot advance D14-07/08/14 prospective fill maturity without mechanism-matched quote/order/fill receipts.
